checks_are: the closed set of checks a rejected answer names (40.5), by route, in the order an SDK applies them

checks.meaning: the body is not JSON: a captive portal's or an edge's page answered with a 2xx
`v` is not 1
`lease` is missing, not base64url, empty or over 4096 bytes
`iat` is missing or not an integer
`exp` is missing or not an integer
`refresh_after` is missing or not an integer
`base` is missing, not https, has no host, is not printable ASCII or does not end with /
`base` names a host off the allow-list (28.1, 28.4)
the binary lease is not of a format and version the Core reads (QLC_D_LEASE_FORMAT)
the lease is not signed by a key the Core pins (QLC_D_LEASE_SIGNATURE)
the lease is for another install key (QLC_D_LEASE_INSTALL)
the lease is for another Core release (QLC_D_LEASE_RELEASE)
the lease is for another build (QLC_D_LEASE_BUILD)
the lease names another key id than the manifest (QLC_D_LEASE_KEY_ID)
the lease is for another model (QLC_D_LEASE_MODEL)
the lease was at or past its exp on the Core's clock when it arrived (QLC_D_LEASE_EXPIRED)
the lease's outer tag does not verify (QLC_D_LEASE_OUTER_TAG)
the lease's inner tag does not verify (QLC_D_LEASE_INNER_TAG)
the web lease is for another site (QLC_D_LEASE_SITE)
a node lease's certificate is malformed (QLC_D_LEASE_CERT_FORMAT, section 36)
a node lease's certificate does not verify (QLC_D_LEASE_CERT_SIGNATURE)
a node lease's certificate names an unknown key (QLC_D_LEASE_CERT_KID)
a node lease's certificate tier does not allow it (QLC_D_LEASE_CERT_TIER)
a node lease's certificate is out of its window (QLC_D_LEASE_CERT_WINDOW)
a node lease outlives what its certificate allows (QLC_D_LEASE_NODE_LIFE)
the install key could not unwrap the lease (QLC_D_LEASE_UNWRAP)
QLC_E_LEASE with a detail this table does not name: `lease_detail:<n>`
the Core refused the signed manifest the lease was asked for (QLC_E_MANIFEST at the accept)
the Core failed for a cause of the device at the accept: `core:<status name>` (keystore, storage, nomem, busy, arg)
`challenge` is missing or not in the strict form c1.<10 digits>.<22>.<22>
`token` is missing or does not start with qlt_
`install_cert` is missing although install keys were sent
the install certificate is not two base64url parts, or its text is not the 13 lines of 18.4.3
the install certificate is not signed by a key the SDK pins
the install certificate names another install hash than the key it was asked for
a 200 shorter or longer than the manifest's size of the file
a 206 for another range, or another file size, than the one asked for
a 206 without a Content-Range the SDK can hold it to
a range that ended cleanly short of what it named
a 2xx that brought no byte
a 2xx other than 200 and 206

not_checks.not_yet_valid: no SDK or Core check: a lease newer than the Core's clock re-anchors it (18.4.7), never refused
not_checks.app_mismatch: no SDK check: the SDK does not compare the certificate's `app` with its own; the server judges it
not_checks.content_type: no SDK check reads the Content-Type header; an API body that is not JSON is `not_json`

core_accept_are: a failed qlc_lease_accept, its status and qlc_detail, to its check (40.5)
lease_answers_are: a 200 body of POST /v1/model-key to the first check it fails before the Core, or null

lease_answers.name: JSON that is not an object
a lease that is not base64url
a base without its last slash
a base on a standby's model host

challenges.name: a challenge not in the strict form

tokens_are: a 200 body of POST /v1/attest (install_keys: sent with install keys) or /v1/attest/assert

tokens.name: a token, no install keys sent
install keys sent, no certificate (the protected model off on that host)

certificates.name: two parts that are not base64url, or 12 lines
signed by a key the SDK does not pin

files_are: an answer of a model file that said success (16.1), to the check it fails, or null

classes.transient: no answer, a stall, a 5xx, a 2xx that is not what was asked on every host, a challenge refused, a platform service failing for the moment: the same key, again after the background wait (and inside the call's budget)
classes.transient_apple: App Attest's DCError.serverUnavailable: the same key and, while the challenge is fresh, the same client data hash; never before APPLE_FLOOR
classes.slow_down: a 429 of the attest routes, or Play over its quota (TOO_MANY_REQUESTS): its Retry-After is the floor of the background wait; no try inside the call; Play over its quota is the named path at once (40.3)
classes.new_key: DCError.invalidKey or invalidInput, attest_key_unknown, assertion_failed, StrongBox unavailable: the key is gone or cannot be used; a new key at once, once per attempt (a second in the same attempt is judged)
classes.judged: the server refused the attestation (attestation_failed, team_mismatch, attest_key_revoked, lease_integrity_failed), App Attest failed with another error (Apple: discard the key), Play failed with an error that is not transient: the key is discarded and SDK 4.0.2's hold applies (1 h, doubling to 24 h)
classes.unsupported: the platform cannot attest on this device or in this process: the named unattested path (40.3); asked again only when the app's release changes
classes.refusal: a refusal that is not about the attestation (a stop, key_revoked, app_blocked, sdk_too_old): the route's own rules (15.3, 18.4.10); not retried by this policy

classify_are: one failure of the attestation to its class (40.2)
background_are: a failure's class and its row to the seconds before the next background try (null: none)
in_call_are: the tries inside one call: when each starts and how the call ends (40.2)

in_call.name: three transient: the background takes over
offline, the network back at 6 s
slow tries: no try after the wall
the key gone: a new key at once
the new key gone too: judged

unattested.meaning: the platform says this device cannot attest: DCAppAttestService.isSupported is false (a Mac without a Secure Enclave, a virtual machine), DCError.featureUnsupported; Android with no hardware attestation and no Play Integrity
the process is an app extension of a kind App Attest does not serve (Apple: only action, extensible SSO and watchOS extensions are)
the binary has no team id (unsigned or ad hoc signed): App Attest cannot work in it
App Attest's service answered DCError.serverUnavailable at every try for 24 hours (6 tries or more) while Quran Lab answered

Play Integrity is not on the device (no Play Store or Play services, too old, no account), or failed for the moment at every try for 24 hours while Quran Lab answered, and the device has no usable hardware chain

named_are: an attestation's failures (second, class, Quran Lab answered, the platform service) to the named unattested path they give (40.3), or null

named.name: Apple unavailable a day, Quran Lab answering
a day offline: nothing answered, no named path
five tries over two days: not enough tries
Play failing a day, Quran Lab answering
Play over its quota once: the named path at once
Quran Lab unreachable a day: not the platform

renew_are: a lease's iat, exp and refresh_after to the time the SDK asks for a new one by itself (40.4)

renew.name: a 14-day lease: the server's refresh_after comes first
a refresh_after past the half-life: the half-life
a 1-day lease: its half-life, a little before the refresh_after of the server
a 1-day lease whose refresh_after is late: half-life

chains_are: the hops an operation recorded (a host name where it had one) to the report's chain (40.6)

chains.name: a renewal every host answered with a lease the Core refused
App Attest offline, the attest offline, then the lease refused
a value that fails its pattern is left out, a hop without a token reason dropped
a host a config added (another provider under an allowed domain) is a standby

plans_are: 40.2 item 1: the config's attest "required" (true) or none (false) and how the certificate's attestation ended inside the call, to the certificate the lease is asked with (null: no lease asked), whether the attestation stays owed, and the tries inside the call (patient: item 3's; one: one try)
upgrades_are: 40.2 item 10: one upgrade try of a capped install (a take in progress, how the attestation ended, how the full lease request ended) to the lease and install key in force after it, whether the upgrade stays owed, and whether the next key and its certificate are kept for the next try

upgrades.name: a take in progress: the upgrade waits
the attestation does not succeed: nothing changes
attested, the full lease accepted: switched
attested, no answer on any host: still capped, still works
attested, a lease the Core refuses: still capped
